'''2007 Worlds Day 3 Brad Eier DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brad Eier]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Typed list spans pages 5–6 of [[:File:2007 Worlds Day 3.pdf]]; scan shows page 5.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brad Eier]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
